headline.en: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC reports 9.06% Class I distribution rate, $23.78 NAV at September 30
headline.zh: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC公布：截至9月30日，Class I份额分配率9.06%，每股净资产23.78美元

summary.en: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC disclosed in an 8-K that its Class I shares generated a 9.06% annualized distribution rate in September 2026, with three-month and one-year total net returns of 2.06% and 6.05% as of September 30, 2026. Annualized inception-to-date total net return was 8.13%, and net asset value per share was $23.78 as of September 30, 2026. The fund described a third-quarter shift in market conditions, including a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike in September and a 10-year Treasury yield of about 5.3%.
summary.zh: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC在8-K中披露，其Class I份额在2026年9月实现9.06%的年化分配率；截至2026年9月30日，三个月和一年总净回报分别为2.06%和6.05%。自成立以来的年化总净回报为8.13%，截至2026年9月30日的每股净资产为23.78美元。该基金称第三季度市场环境出现明显变化，包括美联储9月加息25个基点和10年期美国国债收益率约5.3%。

items.source_headline: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC files 8-K: item 7.01

reason.en: Quarterly BDC performance disclosure with new NAV, distribution and return figures; no credit event, but it updates the economics of Apollo's retail credit vehicle.
reason.zh: BDC季度业绩披露，包含新的每股净资产、分配率和回报数据；无信用事件，但更新了Apollo零售信贷载体的经济表现。

items.relevance_reason: Apollo's flagship non-traded BDC reported quarterly NAV, distribution rate and returns amid a tougher credit and rate backdrop, informing views on Apollo's retail credit franchise performance.

headline.en: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC sells Class I shares, declares distributions; NAV slips to $23.78
headline.zh: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC出售I类份额并宣布分红，每股净资产降至23.78美元

summary.en: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC sold unregistered Class I common shares to feeder vehicles as of October 1, 2026, with the final share count set on October 20, 2026. On October 20 the fund declared distributions for all share classes, payable November 27, 2026, and reported September 30 NAV per share of $23.78 versus $23.84 at August 31. The fund originated about $1.6 billion of private debt in the September quarter at a weighted average spread of 486 basis points, with roughly 100% first lien and 84% floating rate, and its portfolio stood at about $25.5 billion across 377 companies.
summary.zh: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC截至2026年10月1日向联接载体出售未注册的I类普通股，最终股份数量于2026年10月20日确定。该基金于10月20日宣布各类别份额分红，将于2026年11月27日支付，并公布截至9月30日的每股净资产为23.78美元，8月31日为23.84美元。该基金在截至9月30日的季度发起了约16亿美元私募债务投资，加权平均利差486个基点，新增直接投资中约100%为第一留置权、约84%为浮动利率；截至9月30日组合公允价值约255亿美元，覆盖377家公司。

items.relevance_reason: Apollo's flagship BDC discloses new NAV decline, quarterly origination volume and spreads, and a distribution declaration, all of which inform credit investors' view of Apollo's private credit vehicle performance and deployment.

headline.en: Sound Physicians closing $1B private credit refinancing after canceling BSL process
headline.zh: Sound Physicians 取消银团贷款流程后，即将完成10亿美元私募信贷再融资

summary.en: Sound Physicians is closing on a $1B private credit refinancing after canceling a broadly syndicated loan process, according to PitchBook. No lenders or other deal terms were disclosed in the supplied text.
summary.zh: 据 PitchBook 报道，Sound Physicians 在取消银团贷款（BSL）流程后，即将完成10亿美元私募信贷再融资。

items.source_headline: Sound Physicians closing on $1B private credit refinancing after canceling BSL process
items.relevance_reason: A $1B private credit refinancing that displaced a broadly syndicated loan process shows direct lending taking share from syndicated markets, a transmission channel to tracked private credit managers.
